title: Microtek UPS SW E²+ 715 572- Watt Sinewave Inverter (Blackish Grey)
description: Description, Microtek UPS SW E²+ series are super energy efficient UPS with > 87 percent efficiency. It also comes with intelligent feature of battery water level indicator, which ensures timely topping of water in the battery. Designed using latest state-of-the art technology. It comes with many smart features, display status, fault conditions and battery voltage selection switch. The UPS operates from standard voltage range from 100 V~ 300 V and narrow voltage range from 180 V ~ 260 V for running computers and sensitive appliances. Rated capacity 715 VA / 12V, output power 572 watts, battery 1 battery system (12 VDC), waveform sinewave, warranty 2 years. Key Features: Micro controller based intelligent control design. LED display indications for UPS status and fault. CCCV technology with auto trickle mode. Smart overload sense and short circuit protection. Battery state monitoring. • Multi stage battery charger. Mains input voltage range slide selection switch.
Name: Microtek UPS SW E²+ 715 572- Watt Sinewave Inverter (Blackish Grey)
